## How I verified it

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run i18n:check` (if you touched any copy)

## Checklist

- [ ] New copy lives in `i18n/locales/` in **es, en and pt-BR**, not as literal strings.
- [ ] No seed phrases, keys, tokens or personal data in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] I did not bump the version: maintainers do that in `app.json` at release time.
